summary: Vroom, Inc. disclosed an 8-K reporting that subsidiary Vroom Automotive, LLC issued 16,000 Series A1 and 4,000 Series B1 preferred units to SPE Holdings 2026-1 for $20,000,000 gross proceeds under a Preferred Unit Purchase Agreement and Third Amended and Restated LLC Agreement dated September 30, 2026. Series A1 pays SOFR plus 8.50%; Series B1 pays SOFR plus 9.25% and is convertible into Vroom Automotive common units at SPE Holdings' option; Series A1 is not convertible. Proceeds repay obligations and purchase residual ABS trust interests. This is a structured preferred financing, not a control event; watch for overhang and any future conversion mechanics.
